validated_fixes: Physical slot indices now enumerate id_of_slot positions
All-hit warmup uses captured graph only and is bounded
X input and independent linked worktree are mandatory
Hybrid argv retains executable and serve

issues.fix: Reject symlink and writable files, then enforce explicit schema/status and expected candidate/input/script/source hashes for both receipts. Add CPU tests for writable, malformed schema, non-admitted and non-PASS receipts.
issues.root_cause: Receipt helper performs only file/JSON shape validation.
issues.issue: The claimed sealed-admission and controller-review launch guards accept any nonempty regular JSON. They do not reject writable files or validate required admission/controller verdict and immutable binding fields.
issues.impact: An arbitrary JSON receipt bypasses both preconditions while the output misleadingly records their hashes as sealed proofs.

issues.issue: All-hit warmup records steps and missing but omits active counts. A replay with zero active experts in a layer satisfies the current all-layers-no-miss predicate vacuously.
issues.fix: Include active delta and require active >0 per measured layer, recording it in the receipt.
issues.impact: The receipt may not demonstrate an actual routed cache hit in every layer.

validation.limits: CPU unit tests only; no GPU graph/kernel/stream execution

recommendation: REQUEST CHANGES; do not run GPU benchmark from this revision.
